name: Accept dialog after the pull request head moved
description: C-415: when the merge is refused because the pull request moved, the Accept dialog shows a warning with the new short head, a link to its diff and an Accept <sha7> button that merges exactly that head. The demo stack has no runner, so the pull request is unreadable and the dialog shows its accept-only path; the moved-head banner needs a readable open pull request and is covered by the API, Telegram and web unit tests.
